title.en: Munich court largely upholds GEMA’s claims against Suno
title.zhHans: 慕尼黑法院基本支持 GEMA 对 Suno 的诉求

searchSummary.en: Munich Regional Court I largely granted GEMA’s claims against Suno over six musical works, while the first-instance judgment remains appealable.
searchSummary.zhHans: 慕尼黑第一地方法院基本支持 GEMA 就六部音乐作品对 Suno 提出的诉求，但一审判决仍可上诉。

summary.en: Munich Regional Court I largely granted GEMA’s injunction, information and damages claims against Suno concerning six musical works. The court’s press release describes findings on training copies, model memorisation and outputs; the first-instance judgment is not final.
summary.zhHans: 慕尼黑第一地方法院基本支持了 GEMA 就六部音乐作品对 Suno 提出的禁令、信息和损害赔偿请求。法院新闻稿说明了有关训练复制、模型记忆和输出的认定；该一审判决尚未生效终局。

narrative.en: The 42nd Civil Chamber found, on the case record before it, that the works were reproducible in Suno’s models and outputs and that the asserted claims were largely justified. The press release discusses both German and US-law questions in the case, as well as the court’s distinction from US cases involving outputs that did not substantially expose training material. The ruling is a concrete copyright-governance event for generative music, but its procedural status and fact-specific findings matter: it is not a final appeal outcome or a universal judicial answer to AI-training disputes.
narrative.zhHans: 第 42 民事庭依据其审理的案卷认定，这些作品能够在 Suno 的模型和输出中被再现，GEMA 提出的诉求大体成立。新闻稿还讨论了本案中的德国法和美国法问题，以及法院为何将本案与训练材料未被实质性暴露在输出中的美国案件区分开来。该裁决是生成式音乐领域一个具体的版权治理事件，但其程序状态和事实特定性同样重要：它不是上诉终局，也不是对 AI 训练争议的普遍司法答案。

description.en: The judgment makes model memorisation and recognisable output reproduction central judicial questions for a commercial generative-music service in this case.
description.zhHans: 在本案中，该判决将模型记忆和可识别输出的再现置于商业生成式音乐服务的核心司法问题之中。

description.en: The decision increases legal and licensing uncertainty for AI-music providers while rights holders and platforms assess its limited but potentially relevant reasoning.
description.zhHans: 在权利人和平台评估其有限但可能相关的推理时，该判决增加了 AI 音乐提供方的法律和许可不确定性。

text.en: On 31 July 2026, Munich Regional Court I’s 42nd Civil Chamber largely granted GEMA’s injunction, information and damages claims against Suno in case 42 O 763/25 concerning six musical works.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 31 日，慕尼黑第一地方法院第 42 民事庭在案号 42 O 763/25 中，就六部音乐作品相关争议，基本支持了 GEMA 对 Suno 提出的禁令、信息和损害赔偿请求。

text.en: The ruling provides a judicial reference point for disputes over model memorisation, training copies and recognisable outputs in generative-music systems, subject to its case-specific record and appeal status.
text.zhHans: 该裁决为围绕生成式音乐系统的模型记忆、训练复制和可识别输出的争议提供了一个司法参照点，但仍受限于本案记录和上诉状态。

text.en: The court’s press release states that the judgment is not final. Its findings concern the six works and the record before the court and should not be generalized into a universal rule for all AI training or outputs.
text.zhHans: 法院新闻稿明确指出该判决尚未生效终局。其认定针对六部作品及法院审理的案卷，不应被泛化为适用于所有 AI 训练或输出的普遍规则。
